purpose: Preregister native cache-fetch correctness in FP32 and BF16 without post-result tolerance relaxation.
comparison: Every vocabulary logit at every generated step must be finite and satisfy abs(candidate-reference) <= atol + rtol*abs(reference); all greedy token IDs must match.

float32.note: Retain all three original numerical and greedy-token comparisons.

bfloat16.primary_reference: Independent native HF prefix prefill followed by the same batch-shaped suffix and one-token greedy decode used by the restored cache path.
bfloat16.note: Full recompute uses different prefill chunking and remains a numerical diagnostic. Only the prespecified local-cache versus fetched-cache comparison gates BF16 logits and tokens; a failure is reported without widening tolerances.

common_requirements: Actual floating model parameters and transferred cache tensors match the requested dtype.
Peer identity includes model revision and file-manifest hash, source hashes, requested/model/wire dtype, numerical backend settings, and this protocol hash.
TF32 is disabled and float32 matmul precision is highest; BF16/FP16 reduced-precision reduction settings are recorded.
Holder prefix prefill and CUDA synchronization precede the cached-hit request barrier.
Canonical cache metadata and exact tensor bytes have identical SHA256 before transfer, after reception, and after restoration on the destination GPU.
The restored prefix cache has exactly prefix_length tokens and the expected layer/head dimensions and dtype.
Full, local-cache, and fetched-cache final lengths all equal prefix + suffix + generated - 1.
The hit path forwards the suffix once and then one token per decode step; it never prefills the prefix.
All three original cases must pass; cross-node execution requires two distinct hosts.
diagnostics: Record each comparison's maximum/per-step logit error, tolerance ratio, finiteness, greedy-token equality, and whether it gates acceptance.
Record the independently generated local-prefix hash and whether it equals the received prefix; transfer integrity itself compares holder, received, and restored hashes.
limitations: Correctness harness only; Gloo TCP with CPU staging is not GPU-native transport or serving-performance evidence.
BF16 acceptance does not establish numerical chunk-invariance between full prefill and cached-prefix execution.
No selector, progressive repair, or overlap claim is made by this harness.
